Automatic differentiation is often intro.zh:
自动微分常常被介绍成一种反向传播的魔法。
              其实它比这更简单。它是一种通过对中间值进行存储、并在局部应用链式法则，
              从而对实际运行的程序计算精确导数的方法。
Automatic differentiation is often intro.src:
Automatic differentiation is often introduced as if it were just backprop magic.
              It is simpler than that. It is a way to compute exact derivatives of the program you
              actually ran by storing intermediate values and applying the chain rule locally.

Before we touch the interactive graph, w.src:
Before we touch the interactive graph, we will separate autodiff from finite
              differences and symbolic algebra, then sketch the graph mechanics in plain view.

There are three different ideas that often get blurred together. They all answer the
          question “how fast does the output change when the input changes?”, but they do it in

This is what deep-learning frameworks use. It follows the actual computation graph,
              stores the intermediate values from the forward pass, and produces exact derivatives
              up to normal floating-point arithmetic.

Here is the whole idea in still form. The forward pass creates intermediate values from

Reverse-mode autodiff is especially useful in learning because many parameters feed one

The scalar version of autograd can go a long way with a very small lookup table. The
          exact list below matches the pedagogical core from the animation notes: multiplication,

          from these or wrapped into a bigger module that knows how to backprop internally.

优秀的引擎在此保持谦逊：它们存储输出值、记住父节点，

Good engines stay humble here: they stor.src:
Good engines stay humble here: they store the output value, remember the parents, and
            attach a backward rule that converts an upstream gradient into contributions for each
            parent.

A teaching graph should show everything..zh:
用于教学的计算图应展示一切。用于生产的计算图则只展示恰到好处的部分。
          这就是框架把一串微小运算打包成更大模块的原因。线性层隐藏了乘法与加法。
          sigmoid 隐藏了取负、指数、加法与倒数。损失模块则能隐藏更多。
A teaching graph should show everything..src:
A teaching graph should show everything. A production graph should show just enough.
          That is why frameworks package chains of small operations into larger blocks. A linear
          layer hides the multiply and add. A sigmoid hides negation, exponentiation, addition,
          and reciprocal. A loss module can hide still more.

Scroll sideways to compare every block.src: Scroll sideways to compare every block

Atomic graph: every local derivative is.src: Atomic graph: every local derivative is explicit.

当你学习或调试引擎本身时，这是理想形式。每个节点都有一条

This is ideal when you are learning or d.src:
This is ideal when you are learning or debugging the engine itself. Every node has
                a tiny backward rule and every edge is legible.

@@T0@@VI.@@T1@@ Three examples, shared p.src: VI. Three examples, shared parameters, one update

The point of autograd is not a single ex.zh:
自动微分的意义不在于单个样本，而在于反复复用。相同的参数
          会出现在每个样本中，因此反向传播必须在优化器更新参数之前
          累加梯度贡献。仅用三个数据点，你就能亲身感受到批量处理逻辑，
          而不只是把它当作抽象概念。
The point of autograd is not a single ex.src:
The point of autograd is not a single example. It is repeated reuse. The same parameters
          show up in every example, so the backward pass must accumulate gradient contributions
          before the optimizer updates them. With only three points, you can already feel that
          batching logic instead of treating it as abstraction.

Each row produces its own probability, l.zh:
每一行都产生各自的概率、损失与梯度贡献。
              参数更新使用所有行的平均梯度。
Each row produces its own probability, l.src:
Each row produces its own probability, loss, and gradient contribution. The
              parameter update uses the mean gradient over all rows.

@@T0@@VII.@@T1@@ What an autograd engine.zh: @@T0@@VII.@@T1@@ 自动微分引擎真正存储了什么
@@T0@@VII.@@T1@@ What an autograd engine.src: VII. What an autograd engine really stores

The finished story is smaller than the n.zh:
完整的故事比那些记号看起来要小。一个节点存储一个值、
          一组父节点以及一条局部反向规则。前向传播构建计算图，并缓存
          反向规则之后所需的一切。反向传播从标量损失出发，
          按逆拓扑序遍历计算图，并在多条路径汇合处累加贡献。
The finished story is smaller than the n.src:
The finished story is smaller than the notation makes it seem. A node stores a value, a
          set of parents, and a local backward rule. The forward pass builds the graph and caches
          whatever the backward rule will need later. The backward pass starts from the scalar loss,
          walks the graph in reverse topological order, and accumulates contributions whenever
          multiple paths meet.

Every node only needs its own tiny deriv.zh: 每个节点只需知道它自己那条微小的求导法则。
Every node only needs its own tiny deriv.src: Every node only needs its own tiny derivative law.

The engine never differentiates the whol.zh: 引擎从不符号化地对整个模型求导。它组合许多局部事实。
The engine never differentiates the whol.src: The engine never differentiates the whole model symbolically. It composes many local facts.

Forward values are saved because backwar.zh: 前向值之所以被保存，是因为反向规则需要它们。
Forward values are saved because backwar.src: Forward values are saved because backward rules need them.

For @@T0@@\\log(a)@@T1@@ you need @@T2@@.zh: 对于 @@T0@@\log(a)@@T1@@ 你需要 @@T2@@a@@T3@@；对于 @@T4@@1/a@@T5@@ 你需要 @@T6@@a@@T7@@；对于 sigmoid，通常需要其输出。
For @@T0@@\\log(a)@@T1@@ you need @@T2@@.src: For \log(a) you need a; for 1/a you need a; for sigmoid you usually need the output.

They are just larger nodes with richer i.zh: 它们只不过是内部反向规则更丰富的更大节点。
They are just larger nodes with richer i.src: They are just larger nodes with richer internal backward rules.

This is how @@T0@@nn.Linear@@T1@@, @@T2@.zh: 这正是 @@T0@@nn.Linear@@T1@@、@@T2@@sigmoid@@T3@@ 与交叉熵得以既易用又保持可微的方式。
This is how @@T0@@nn.Linear@@T1@@, @@T2@.src: This is how nn.Linear, sigmoid, and cross-entropy stay ergonomic while remaining differentiable.

The same parameters receive many gradien.zh: 在更新之前，相同的参数会收到多条梯度信息。
The same parameters receive many gradien.src: The same parameters receive many gradient messages before the update.

The optimizer step is simple only becaus.zh: 优化器步骤之所以简单，只是因为自动微分已经把所有依赖于这些参数的量都求和了。
The optimizer step is simple only becaus.src: The optimizer step is simple only because autograd already summed everything that depended on those parameters.

If this clicked, the next good exercise.zh:
如果这一节让你理解了，那么下一个不错的练习就是自己动手实现标量引擎。
          让计算图保持小巧，让规则手册保持简短，让反向传播保持诚实。

If this clicked, the next good exercise is to build the scalar engine yourself. Keep the
          graph tiny, keep the rulebook short, and keep the backward pass honest.

meta.title: 再看自动微分
meta.tagline: 自动微分是什么、不是什么，以及梯度如何在计算图中流动
meta.summary: 一篇关于自动微分的可视化讲解：先区分自动微分与有限差分、符号代数，再对一个计算图进行完整的前向与反向演示，最后展示模块化与 mini-batch 训练。
highlights: 在接触交互式计算图之前，先清晰比较有限差分、符号微分与自动微分。
观察单个标量计算图如何逐步揭示前向传播中的值与反向传播中的梯度。
让主图保持简洁，由单独的账本解释驱动当前步骤的精确“上游乘局部”规则。
在原子运算与框架式模块之间切换，看清 PyTorch 或 JAX 究竟隐藏了什么。
探索一个仅含三个样本的小批量，其中相同参数从多个样本获得梯度贡献。

The example arrives as @@T0@@x = [[[0]]].zh: 样本以 @@T0@@x = [[[0]]]@@T1@@ 的形式给出。可学习参数初始为 @@T2@@w = [[[1]]]@@T3@@ 与 @@T4@@b = [[[2]]]@@T5@@。因为损失尚未构建，所以还不存在任何梯度。
The example arrives as @@T0@@x = [[[0]]].src: The example arrives as x = ${formatNumber(s.values.x)}. The learnable parameters start at w = ${formatNumber(s.values.w)} and b = ${formatNumber(s.values.b)}. No gradients exist yet because the loss has not been built.

Multiplication creates @@T0@@wx = [[[0]].src: Multiplication creates wx = ${formatNumber(s.values.mul)}. Later, when gradients return, this node will send x back to w and w back to x.

The add node combines the weighted input.zh: 加法节点将加权输入与偏置结合，生成 @@T0@@z = [[[0]]]@@T1@@。加法在反向传播中很简单：它把上游梯度复制给两个父节点。
The add node combines the weighted input.src: The add node combines the weighted input and the bias to produce z = ${formatNumber(s.values.z)}. Addition is simple on the backward pass: it copies the upstream gradient to both parents.

The graph now stores @@T0@@-z = [[[0]]]@.zh: 计算图现在存储 @@T0@@-z = [[[0]]]@@T1@@。这次取负看似微小，但之后很重要，因为它贡献了 @@T2@@-1@@T3@@ 的局部导数。
The graph now stores @@T0@@-z = [[[0]]]@.src: The graph now stores -z = ${formatNumber(s.values.neg)}. This sign flip is small, but it matters later because it contributes a local derivative of -1.

The exponential node stores @@T0@@e^{-z}.zh: 指数节点存储 @@T0@@e^{-z} = [[[0]]]@@T1@@。由于 @@T2@@e^a@@T3@@ 的导数就是它自身，前向输出正是反向规则所需要的。
The exponential node stores @@T0@@e^{-z}.src: The exponential node stores e^{-z} = ${formatNumber(s.values.exp)}. Because the derivative of e^a is itself, the forward output is exactly what the backward rule will need.

Adding @@T0@@1@@T1@@ produces @@T2@@d =.zh: 加上 @@T0@@1@@T1@@ 得到 @@T2@@d = [[[0]]]@@T3@@。这个隐含常数在视觉上并不重要，因此图中省略了它，但数值状态仍然体现了它。
Adding @@T0@@1@@T1@@ produces @@T2@@d =.src: Adding 1 produces d = ${formatNumber(s.values.denom)}. The hidden constant is not visually important, so the diagram omits it, but the numeric state still reflects it.

The sigmoid output is @@T0@@p = [[[0]]]@.zh: sigmoid 输出为 @@T0@@p = [[[0]]]@@T1@@。对这个正类样本而言，概率越大意味着损失越小。
The sigmoid output is @@T0@@p = [[[0]]]@.src: The sigmoid output is p = ${formatNumber(s.values.p)}. For this positive example, larger probabilities mean smaller loss.

The graph stores @@T0@@\\\\log(p) = [[[0.zh: 计算图存储 @@T0@@\\log(p) = [[[0]]]@@T1@@。对数把概率转换为一个当模型出错时会急剧增大的量。
The graph stores @@T0@@\\\\log(p) = [[[0.src: The graph stores \\log(p) = ${formatNumber(s.values.logp)}. The log turns a probability into a quantity that grows sharply when the model is wrong.

Negating the log produces @@T0@@L = [[[0.zh: 对对数取负得到 @@T0@@L = [[[0]]]@@T1@@。只有到这时反向传播才能开始，因为引擎终于有了可供求导的标量目标。
Negating the log produces @@T0@@L = [[[0.src: Negating the log produces L = ${formatNumber(s.values.L)}. Only now can the backward pass begin, because the engine has a scalar target to differentiate.

Every reverse pass starts with @@T0@@\\\.zh: 每一次反向传播都以 @@T0@@\\partial L / \\partial L = 1@@T1@@ 起始。这个种子表明：若损失发生微小变化，它就恰好变化这么多。
Every reverse pass starts with @@T0@@\\\.src: Every reverse pass starts with \\partial L / \\partial L = 1. That seed says: if the loss changes by a little, it changes by exactly that much.

Because @@T0@@L = -\\\\log(p)@@T1@@, the.zh: 因为 @@T0@@L = -\\log(p)@@T1@@，所以 @@T2@@\\log p@@T3@@ 处的梯度变为 @@T4@@[[[0]]]@@T5@@。结构已经很清晰：上游梯度乘以局部导数。
Because @@T0@@L = -\\\\log(p)@@T1@@, the.src: Because L = -\\log(p), the gradient at \\log p becomes ${formatNumber(s.grads.logp)}. The structure is already visible: upstream gradient times local derivative.

The local derivative of @@T0@@\\\\log(p).zh: @@T0@@\\log(p)@@T1@@ 的局部导数是 @@T2@@1/p@@T3@@，因此概率接收到的梯度为 @@T4@@[[[0]]]@@T5@@。越自信却越错误的概率受到的惩罚越大。
The local derivative of @@T0@@\\\\log(p).src: The local derivative of \\log(p) is 1/p, so the probability receives gradient ${formatNumber(s.grads.p)}. Confident wrong probabilities get punished the most.

The denominator inherits gradient @@T0@@.zh: 分母继承的梯度为 @@T0@@[[[0]]]@@T1@@。这一步正是倒数规则充分发挥作用之处：取负号、分母平方。
The denominator inherits gradient @@T0@@.src: The denominator inherits gradient ${formatNumber(s.grads.denom)}. This is the step where the reciprocal rule does its full job: negative sign, squared denominator.

Since the derivative of @@T0@@e^{-z}@@T1.zh: 由于 @@T0@@e^{-z}@@T1@@ 的导数是 @@T2@@e^{-z}@@T3@@，取负后的 logit 接收到的梯度为 @@T4@@[[[0]]]@@T5@@。这正是缓存前向输出如此有用的原因。
Since the derivative of @@T0@@e^{-z}@@T1.src: Since the derivative of e^{-z} is e^{-z}, the negated logit receives gradient ${formatNumber(s.grads.neg)}. This is why caching the forward output is so useful.

The gradient at the logit becomes @@T0@@.zh: logit 处的梯度变为 @@T0@@[[[0]]]@@T1@@。对于正类样本，该值等于 @@T2@@p - 1@@T3@@，这正是当概率仍小于 1 时优化器会把 logit 往上推的原因。
The gradient at the logit becomes @@T0@@.src: The gradient at the logit becomes ${formatNumber(s.grads.z)}. For a positive example, this value equals p - 1, which is why the optimizer will push the logit upward when the probability is still below one.

Both @@T0@@wx@@T1@@ and @@T2@@b@@T3@@ re.zh: @@T0@@wx@@T1@@ 与 @@T2@@b@@T3@@ 都接收 @@T4@@[[[0]]]@@T5@@。这是规则表中最干净的一条：加法只是把上游梯度原样转发。
Both @@T0@@wx@@T1@@ and @@T2@@b@@T3@@ re.src: Both wx and b receive ${formatNumber(s.grads.z)}. This is the cleanest rule in the table: addition simply forwards the upstream gradient unchanged.

Because the other parent acts as the loc.zh: 因为另一个父节点充当局部导数，所以权重接收 @@T0@@[[[0]]]@@T1@@，而若我们需要输入端的梯度，它会接收 @@T2@@[[[1]]]@@T3@@。
Because the other parent acts as the loc.src: Because the other parent acts as the local derivative, the weight receives ${formatNumber(s.grads.w)} and the input would receive ${formatNumber(s.grads.x)} if we needed it.

For this example, the optimizer sees @@T.zh: 对这个样本，优化器看到 @@T0@@dL/dw = [[[0]]]@@T1@@ 与 @@T2@@dL/db = [[[1]]]@@T3@@。在批量中，这些信息会在更新之前跨多个样本累加。
For this example, the optimizer sees @@T.src: For this example, the optimizer sees dL/dw = ${formatNumber(s.grads.w)} and dL/db = ${formatNumber(s.grads.b)}. In a batch, those messages would be accumulated across many examples before the update.

[[[0]]] The current batch gradient wants.src: ${snapshot.dataset.description} The current batch gradient wants to move w ${directionW} and b ${directionB}. After one step, the parameters would become w = ${formatNumber(snapshot.nextW, 2)} and b = ${formatNumber(snapshot.nextB, 2)}.

One input becomes the scale factor for t.zh: 一个输入的取值成为另一个输入梯度的缩放因子。
One input becomes the scale factor for t.src: One input becomes the scale factor for the other input\'s gradient.

When two values are multiplied, each par.zh: 当两个值相乘时，每个父节点接收的上游梯度都会以另一个父节点为比例进行缩放。这是线性层最重要的规则，因为权重与激活值正是在此相遇。
When two values are multiplied, each par.src: When two values are multiplied, each parent receives the upstream gradient scaled by the other parent. This is the most important rule for linear layers because weights and activations meet here.

Addition just copies the upstream gradie.zh: 加法只是把上游梯度复制给每个父节点。
Addition just copies the upstream gradie.src: Addition just copies the upstream gradient to every parent.

An addition node does not scale anything.zh: 加法节点不做任何缩放。每个父节点都原样接收相同的上游信息。当多条路径汇合时，梯度累加正是在这里变得可见。
An addition node does not scale anything.src: An addition node does not scale anything. Each parent receives the same upstream message unchanged. This is where gradient accumulation becomes visible when many paths merge.

The derivative of an exponential is the.zh: 指数函数的导数就是它自身。
The derivative of an exponential is the.src: The derivative of an exponential is the exponential itself.

This is why the forward pass caches outp.zh: 这正是前向传播会缓存输出的原因。一旦已知 e^a，反向规则便立即可得：把上游梯度乘以那个存储的输出。
This is why the forward pass caches outp.src: This is why the forward pass caches outputs. Once you already know e^a, the backward rule is immediate: multiply the upstream gradient by that stored output.

Reciprocals flip the sign and square the.zh: 倒数会翻转符号并对分母取平方。
Reciprocals flip the sign and square the.src: Reciprocals flip the sign and square the denominator.

The sigmoid can be built from a reciproc.zh: sigmoid 可以先构造分母，再通过倒数来实现。此处的符号翻转是学习者常常跟丢思路的环节之一，因此把它单独拎出来会有所帮助。
The sigmoid can be built from a reciproc.src: The sigmoid can be built from a reciprocal after creating a denominator. The sign flip here is one of the moments where learners often lose the thread, so it helps to isolate it.

The log turns multiplication into additi.zh: 对数把乘法变为加法，并把它的梯度变为倒数。
The log turns multiplication into additi.src: The log turns multiplication into addition and its gradient into a reciprocal.

Cross-entropy style losses end with a lo.zh: 交叉熵式损失以对数收尾。一旦上游梯度到达对数节点，剩下的局部工作就只有乘以 1/a。
Cross-entropy style losses end with a lo.src: Cross-entropy style losses end with a logarithm. Once the upstream gradient reaches the log node, the only local work left is multiplying by 1/a.

Inputs are known before any work happens.zh: 在任何运算发生之前，输入是已知的。
Inputs are known before any work happens.src: Inputs are known before any work happens.

The first operation forms the weighted i.zh: 第一个运算生成加权输入。
The first operation forms the weighted i.src: The first operation forms the weighted input.

Adding the bias produces the logit..src: Adding the bias produces the logit.

Sigmoid starts by flipping the sign of t.zh: sigmoid 首先翻转 logit 的符号。
Sigmoid starts by flipping the sign of t.src: Sigmoid starts by flipping the sign of the logit.

Exponentiation turns the negated logit i.zh: 指数运算把取负后的 logit 变为一个正的缩放因子。
Exponentiation turns the negated logit i.src: Exponentiation turns the negated logit into a positive scale.

A denominator appears for the reciprocal.zh: 为了倒数步骤，一个分母出现了。
A denominator appears for the reciprocal.src: A denominator appears for the reciprocal step.

The reciprocal converts the denominator.zh: 倒数把分母转换为概率。
The reciprocal converts the denominator.src: The reciprocal converts the denominator into a probability.

The loss path takes a logarithm..zh: 损失路径进行对数运算。
The loss path takes a logarithm..src: The loss path takes a logarithm.

The scalar loss is now ready..src: The scalar loss is now ready.

Backprop starts by seeding the loss with.zh: 反向传播首先以梯度 1 为损失播种。
Backprop starts by seeding the loss with.src: Backprop starts by seeding the loss with gradient 1.

The final negate sends a clean gradient.zh: 最后的取负把一个干净的梯度 -1 发送给 log p。
The final negate sends a clean gradient.src: The final negate sends a clean gradient of -1 to log p.

The log converts the gradient into a rec.zh: 对数把梯度转换为倒数比例。
The log converts the gradient into a rec.src: The log converts the gradient into a reciprocal scale.

The reciprocal flips the sign and square.zh: 倒数翻转符号并对分母取平方。
The reciprocal flips the sign and square.src: The reciprocal flips the sign and squares the denominator.

Exponentiation scales the upstream messa.zh: 指数运算用自身的输出缩放上游信息。
Exponentiation scales the upstream messa.src: Exponentiation scales the upstream message by its own output.

The negate node flips the sign once more.zh: 取负节点再一次翻转符号。
The negate node flips the sign once more.src: The negate node flips the sign once more.

The add node copies the same message to.zh: 加法节点把同一条信息复制给两个父节点。
The add node copies the same message to.src: The add node copies the same message to both parents.

The multiply node turns the logit gradie.zh: 乘法节点把 logit 梯度转换为参数梯度。
The multiply node turns the logit gradie.src: The multiply node turns the logit gradient into parameter gradients.

Optimizer-ready gradients.zh: 可供优化器使用的梯度

The backward pass ends with gradients on.zh: 反向传播结束时，梯度落在叶节点上。
The backward pass ends with gradients on.src: The backward pass ends with gradients on the leaves.

Atomic graph: every local derivative is.zh: 原子计算图：每个局部导数都是显式的。
Atomic graph: every local derivative is.src: Atomic graph: every local derivative is explicit.

This is ideal for learning the engine it.zh: 这对学习引擎本身而言是理想形式。每个节点都很小，每条依赖关系都可见，每条反向规则都是一行局部事实。
This is ideal for learning the engine it.src: This is ideal for learning the engine itself. Every node is tiny, every dependency is visible, and every backward rule is a one-line local fact.

The weight-input multiply and the bias a.zh: 权重与输入的乘法以及偏置加法以独立步骤出现。
The weight-input multiply and the bias a.src: The weight-input multiply and the bias add appear as separate steps.

It is just negate, exponent, add one, an.zh: 它不过是取负、指数、加一与倒数。
It is just negate, exponent, add one, an.src: It is just negate, exponent, add one, and reciprocal.

A log and a final negate complete the sc.zh: 一次对数运算与一次最终取负构成完整的标量目标。
A log and a final negate complete the sc.src: A log and a final negate complete the scalar objective.

Framework blocks: the same math, fewer v.zh: 框架模块：相同的数学，更少的可见节点。
Framework blocks: the same math, fewer v.src: Framework blocks: the same math, fewer visible nodes.

PyTorch, JAX, and friends do not delete.zh: PyTorch、JAX 等同侪并没有删除链式法则。它们把许多微小运算打包在更大的接口之后，而这些接口中的每一个仍然懂得如何反向传播。
PyTorch, JAX, and friends do not delete.src: PyTorch, JAX, and friends do not delete the chain rule. They package many tiny operations behind larger interfaces, each of which still knows how to backpropagate.

Hides the multiply-and-add details while.zh: 隐藏乘法与加法的细节，同时仍产生可微的输出。
Hides the multiply-and-add details while.src: Hides the multiply-and-add details while still producing a differentiable output.

Encapsulates several scalar ops but can.zh: 封装了若干标量运算，但仍能返回正确的梯度。
Encapsulates several scalar ops but can.src: Encapsulates several scalar ops but can still return the correct gradient.

Acts like one clean block even though it.zh: 尽管其反向规则内部可能经过优化，它表现得就像一个干净的模块。
Acts like one clean block even though it.src: Acts like one clean block even though its backward rule may be optimized internally.

Two negatives sit on the left and one po.zh: 左侧有两个负类样本，右侧有一个正类样本。该批次主要要求更陡的正向斜率。
Two negatives sit on the left and one po.src: Two negatives sit on the left and one positive sits on the right. The batch mainly asks for a steeper positive slope.

All three points live near the decision.zh: 三个点都位于决策边界附近，因此更新必须谨慎地同时移动斜率与截距。
All three points live near the decision.src: All three points live near the decision boundary, so the update has to move both the slope and the offset carefully.

An outlier pushes against the other two.zh: 一个离群点与其他两行相抵触，这正是让梯度平均变得真切可感的那类张力。
An outlier pushes against the other two.src: An outlier pushes against the other two rows, which is exactly the kind of tension that makes gradient averaging feel real.

Nodes relevant to the current stage.src: Nodes relevant to the current stage
